title: Extract the pane measurement baseline and the shared-stream tests, and pin stale-key observer deliveries
outcome: Review follow-ups from the tm-7cu.43 dual-agent pass (2026-09-06), to land as pure code moves after the changeset itself: (1) ui/src/SessionPaneView.scroll.ts is about 3,400 lines; the measurement-baseline cache (captureResizeMeasurement, consumeResizeMeasurement, resizeMeasurementBaselineRef, resolvedConversationPageRef, pendingConversationPageChangeRef) is a cohesive unit that belongs next to SessionPaneView.resize-measurement.ts - move it with a header comment stating what it owns, what it does not (repin policy, FOLLOW/STAY), and the file it was split from, with no behaviour change; (2) ui/src/backend-connection.test.tsx is about 5,000 lines; the shared-stream hydration block is self-contained and should move to its own test file with shared fixtures; (3) the reworked observer path returns early on a stale scroll-state key without calling clearSeenTailIndicator (judged a correctness improvement by review) - add a test pinning that a stale-key delivery neither writes scrollTop nor touches the seen-tail indicator, so the behaviour is deliberate rather than incidental. Owner: Termal::Scroll, after tm-7cu.43 lands.
